house_info.share_warning_body: Noma ubani onale kiyi angacela ukufinyelela ohlwini lomndeni. Yabelana kuphela namalungu owethembele kuwo futhi usebenzise isiteshi esiyimfihlo.
house_info.reveal_confirm_body: Lo kiyi linikeza izicelo zokufinyelela ekhaya. Qinisekisa ukuthi akekho omunye ongabona isikrini sakho ngaphambi kokuqhubeka.
house_info.copy_confirm_body: Kopisha kuphela uma usukulungele ukuwufaka emyalezweni owethembele kuwo noma kumphathi wephasiwedi ovikelekile.
house_info.copy_confirm_tip: Ungafaki lokhu ezingxoxweni zamaqembu, ezithombeni-skrini, noma kunoma iyiphi indlela ongayithemba nekhodi yangaphambili yomnyango wakho.

legal.privacy_policy_content:
## Uhlolojikelele
**{{brandName}}** isofthiwe yomthombo ovulekile futhi ingase inikezwe ngokufaka okusemthethweni noma okuzibambele wena. Ngalokhu kufakwa, isilawuli sedatha noma u-opharetha wesevisi ngu-*{{controllerName}}**.
- **Ikheli lesilawuli:** {{controllerAddress}}
- **Oxhumana naye ngasese:** {{privacyEmail}}
- **Oxhumana naye wosekelo olujwayelekile:** {{supportEmail}}

Lesi saziso sichaza **iyiphi idatha yomuntu siqu ecutshungulwayo**, **itholwa kanjani**, **kungani icutshungulwa**, **ubani ongayithola**, **igcinwa isikhathi esingakanani**, kanye **maphi amalungelo ongase ube nawo**.

Uma lokhu kufakwa kusetshenziswa inkampani yangaphandle, lowo mqhubi unesibopho sanoma ikuphi ubunikazi besilawuli obuthile bokusebenzisa, izibopho zosekelo, imininingwane yokudlulisa, izilungiselelo zokugcinwa, nezaziso zomthetho zendawo ezisebenzayo.

## Iyiphi idatha esiyiqoqayo nesiyicubungulayo
- **Idatha ye-akhawunti:** igama lomsebenzisi, ikheli le-imeyili, i-hashi yephasiwedi, amakhukhi eseshini, idatha yedivayisi ethembekile, namalogi okuphepha.
- **Idatha yesevisi:** izindlu, amagumbi, izigaba, izinto, imidiya elayishiwe, izicelo zokuboleka, namarekhodi omuntu siqu owakhayo.
- **Idatha yobuchwepheshe:** Ikheli le-IP, izihlonzi zesiphequluli/zeseshini, kanye nedatha ethandwayo yolimi edingekayo ukuze kwenziwe okwasendaweni nokuvikeleka kwe-akhawunti.
- **Idatha yomhlinzeki kamazisi ozikhethela yona:** uma ukhetha Ukungena Ngemvume kwe-Google, i-Google yabelana nathi ngekheli lakho le-imeyili, isihlonzi se-akhawunti ye-Google, kanye negama lesibonisi sephrofayela ukuze sikuqinisekise noma sidale i-akhawunti yakho.
- **Idatha yesicelo sokubheka ozikhethelayo:** uma usebenzisa ibhakhodi noma ukubheka umkhiqizo, inani lebhakhodi olithumelayo lingase lithunyelwe iseva yethu kokuthi Vula Amaqiniso Okudla, Amaqiniso Ngemikhiqizo Evuliwe, Amaqiniso Obuhle Avulekile, noma i-Google ukuze umphumela oceliwe ubuyiselwe.

## Siyithola kanjani idatha
- **Ngokuqondile kusuka kuwe:** lapho ubhalisa, ungena ngemvume, udala noma uhlela amarekhodi, ulayisha imidiya, ulungisa izilungiselelo zokuphepha, noma uxhumane nosekelo.
- **Ngokuzenzakalelayo kusuka kusiphequluli sakho noma idivayisi:** ngamakhukhi esikhathi esidingekayo, izindlela ezithenjwayo zamadivayisi, ukuphatha i-IP, okuthandwayo kolimi, namalogi okuvikela adingekayo ukuze kusetshenziswe futhi kuvikelwe uhlelo lokusebenza.
- **Kusuka ku-Google:** kuphela uma ukhetha ukungena ngemvume kwe-Google, kukhawulelwe kudatha kamazisi edingekayo ukuze uqinisekise wena noma udale i-akhawunti yakho.
- **Kusukela emithonjeni yedatha yomkhiqizo wangaphandle:** kuphela uma ucupha ibhakhodi noma ukubheka umkhiqizo, kukhawulelwe esicelweni sokubheka futhi ubuyisele imethadatha yomkhiqizo.

## Kungani siyicubungula
- **Ukusebenza kwe-akhawunti:** ukudala nokusebenzisa i-akhawunti yakho.
- **Ukuqinisekisa nokuvikeleka:** ukukugunyaza futhi uvikele izikhathi kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwezinto ezimbili.
- **Izici ezibalulekile:** ukuhlinzeka ngempahla, ikhophi yasenqolobaneni, kanye nezici ze-Personal Vault.
- **Ukusekela:** ukuphendula izicelo zokusekela.
- **Izici zokungena ngemvume ozikhethelayo nokubheka:** ukuze uqedele Ukungena Ngemvume kwe-Google kanye nokubheka ibhakhodi/umkhiqizo wangaphandle kuphela uma ukhetha lezo zici.
- **Izibopho zomthetho nezokuphepha:** ukwanelisa izibopho zomthetho noma zokuphepha.

## Isisekelo esisemthethweni nendlela yokuqoqa
- **Ngaphansi kwe-GDPR, lapho kufanele khona:** ukucubungula kusekelwe ekusebenzeni kwenkontileka, izibopho zomthetho, imvume yanoma yisiphi isici esisekelwe emvume, kanye nentshisekelo esemthethweni yomsebenzisi kusevisi nokuvikeleka kwe-akhawunti.
- **Ngaphansi kwe-KVKK, lapho kufanele khona:** ukucubungula kusekelwe ezisekelweni ezingokomthetho eziku-Athikili 5 no-6, okuhlanganisa lapho kudingekile khona ukuze kusungulwe noma kwenziwe inkontileka, ukuthobela izibopho zomthetho, ukusetshenziswa noma ukuvikelwa kwamalungelo, noma izithakazelo ezisemthethweni zomlawuli inqobo nje uma amalungelo akho ayisisekelo nenkululeko ingalinyazwa.
- **Indlela yokuqoqa:** idatha iqoqwa ngezindlela ze-elekthronikhi ngamafomu, izikhathi eziqinisekisiwe, amakhukhi adingekayo, ukugeleza kwe-OAuth ongakukhetha, amalogi ezinhlelo zokusebenza, okulayishiwe, nezicelo ze-API.

## Isitoreji nokudlulisa
- **Asithengisi idatha yomuntu siqu.**
- Idatha yomuntu siqu ingase yamukelwe ukusingathwa, isizindalwazi, isitoreji, i-imeyili, ukuqinisekiswa, nabahlinzeki bengqalasizinda abasetshenziselwa ukusebenzisa lokhu kufakwa.
- Uma ukhetha ukungena ngemvume kwe-Google noma ukubheka ibhakhodi/umkhiqizo, ukuqinisekiswa okufanelekile noma idatha yokubheka kwabelwa umhlinzeki okhethiwe ukuze kuqedelwe isici osiqalisile.
- Idatha ingase idalulwe ezinkantolo, abalawuli, noma iziphathimandla zomphakathi lapho kudingeka ngokomthetho.
- **Dlulisela ukudalulwa kwalokhu kufakwa:** {{transferDisclosure}}
- Idatha ye-akhawunti iyagcinwa ngenkathi i-akhawunti yakho isebenza.
- Uma ususa i-akhawunti yakho kokuthi Izilungiselelo, idatha ye-akhawunti yakho, okuqukethwe kwe-vault yomuntu siqu, imidiya elayishiwe, namarekhodi ohlelo lokusebenza e-akhawunti yakho ayasuswa esicelweni ngaphandle kokubambezeleka okungadingekile, ngaphandle kolwazi okufanele lugcinwe ngenxa yezimangalo ezingokomthetho, imisebenzi esemthethweni, noma izibopho zokuphepha.

## Amalungelo akho
- Kuye ngomthetho osebenzayo, ungase ucele isiqinisekiso sokuthi idatha yakho yomuntu siqu iyacutshungulwa yini, ifinyelele kuyo, kanye nolwazi mayelana nezinjongo, izigaba, abamukeli, nokudluliswa.
- Ungacela ukulungiswa, ukusulwa, ukucekelwa phansi, ukuvinjelwa, noma ukuphikisa, futhi lapho kufanele khona ukuphatheka kwedatha.
- Lapho ukucubungula kusekelwe emvumeni, ungahoxisa imvume nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ngaphandle kokuphazamisa ukucubungula okusemthethweni kwangaphambili.
- Ungase ucele ukuthi ukulungiswa, ukususwa, noma imiphumela yokucekelwa phansi idluliselwe kubamukeli lapho umthetho udinga khona lokhu.
- Ungase uphikise imiphumela ekhiqizwe ngendlela ezenzakalelayo kuphela uma umthetho ukunika lelo lungelo.
- Lapho kuvunyelwe ngokomthetho, ungase ufune isinxephezelo ngomonakalo odalwe ukucubungula okungekho emthethweni.
- Ungafaka isikhalazo ku-*{{complaintAuthority}}**

## Asetshenziswa kanjani amalungelo
- Sebenzisa ukugeleza kokususwa kwe-akhawunti yangaphakathi nohlelo noma xhumana no-*{{privacyEmail}}** ngezicelo zobumfihlo.
- Lapho kusebenza khona i-GDPR, izicelo kufanele ziphendulwe ngaphandle kokubambezeleka okungadingekile futhi ngokomgomo phakathi nenyanga engu-1 ngemva kokuqinisekiswa kobuwena.

## Ukwenza izinqumo okuzenzakalelayo
- Lolu hlelo lokusebenza alusebenzisi kuphela ukwenza izinqumo okuzenzakalelayo noma ukwenza iphrofayela okukhiqiza imiphumela esemthethweni noma ebalulekile efanayo kuwe.

## Inothi elibalulekile
Lesi saziso sihlinzekelwe ukuthi kube sobala. **Ihlukile kunoma yikuphi ukuzikhethela kokuthengisa, izibalo, noma imvume yekhukhi engabalulekile**, okumele icelwe ngokuhlukile uma kudingeka.

Abanakekeli bephrojekthi yomthombo ovulekile okhuphukayo ababona isilawuli sedatha ngokuzenzakalelayo noma iphrosesa yokuthunyelwa okusingathwa okuvela eceleni.

Imigomo Yesevisi

1. Uhlolojikelele
I-{{brandName}} isofthiwe yomthombo ovulekile futhi ingasetshenziswa ngokufaka okusemthethweni noma okuzibambele wena. Le migomo isebenza ekufakeni okuthile okusebenzisayo.
- Uma lokhu kufakwa kusetshenziswa inkampani yangaphandle, lowo msebenzisi angase agcwalise le migomo ngemithetho eqondene nokuthunyelwa, izibopho zosekelo, noma izaziso zomthetho zendawo.

2. Imithetho Yokusebenzisa
- Unesibopho sokuba semthethweni, ukunemba, kanye nobunikazi bokuqukethwe okubeka kusevisi.
- Ukutholakala komthombo ovulekile wesofthiwe akukuniki amalungelo okulayisha, ukugcina, noma ukwabelana ngedatha ongagunyaziwe ukuyisebenzisa.
- Singase simise okwesikhashana noma sisuse ama-akhawunti ahlukumeza isevisi, aphule le migomo, noma sakhe ukuphepha noma ubungozi bomthetho.

3. Ukuphepha Kwe-akhawunti
- Gcina iphasiwedi yakho, izinto zokutakula, nezipele zivikelekile.

4. I-Data Lifecycle
- Gcina izipele zakho zolwazi olubalulekile.
- Ukususa i-akhawunti yakho kokuthi Izilungiselelo kususa unaphakade idatha yohlelo lokusebenza kanye nemidiya elayishiwe ephethwe i-akhawunti yakho futhi ngeke kuhlehliswe.

5. Imikhawulo kanye Nomshwana Wokuzikhipha Emthwalweni
- Ukutholakala, ukusekela, ukuhlanganiswa, kanye nezikhathi zokuphendula kuncike ku-opharetha walokhu kufakwa.
- Isevisi ihlinzekwa ngesisekelo sokuthi "njengoba injalo" futhi "njengoba itholakala" ngokwezinga elivunyelwe umthetho.
